title: What they say when they need space
hook: Space isn't rejection. Read it again.
end_sub: Say it properly. Comment the number.
items: I'm overloaded, not leaving. Give me time.
I'm drained and I don't want to snap at you.
I need time to think so I can say it kindly.
I'm stretched thin and don't know how to say so.
Do you have to be so loud?
My head is full. Please turn it down a notch.
